title: Intel Corporation Form 10-Q for the quarter ended June 27, 2026
excerpt: At June 27 Intel held $29.727 billion of cash and short-term investments against $50.537 billion of debt; first-half operating cash flow was $8.102 billion.
summary: The quarterly filing supports segment economics, external foundry progress, balance-sheet and cash-flow analysis, capital intensity, dilution, restructuring, and operating and competitive risks.
